title: DOUKI’s unlikely junior championship breakthrough
summary: DOUKI rises from an overlooked supporting role to challenge his former Suzuki-gun teammate El Desperado. Their title exchanges bookend his first reign, with its ending caused by an actual injury.

chapters.title: DOUKI becomes champion
chapters.result: DOUKI defeats Desperado for the IWGP junior title.
chapters.context: The underdog’s first championship victory changes his place in the division and gives the rivalry a new balance.

chapters.title: An injury stops the Dome rematch
chapters.result: Desperado wins the title by referee stoppage after DOUKI injures his arm.
chapters.context: The real injury interrupts the championship match; it is not treated here as a scripted betrayal or planned dramatic finish.
